summary: Kootenai NF 10' pole L-4 tower built 1934 near Yaak; listed as gone. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone for a number of years; no source describes what remains at the site

evidence.supports: built 1934 as a 10' pole L-4 tower; gone for a number of years
evidence.quote: This 10' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, has been gone for a number of years.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Lucky Point as tower gone, at 48.77900 north and 115.88546 west
Lincoln County list names Lucky Point under Kootenai National Forest

notes_for_editor: Gone status agrees across the FFLA table and firelookout.com; the 1934 date rests on firelookout.com alone. The page's '10'' is ambiguous (pole height or another measure); the story quotes it as written. Location checks out: the record point lies about 9 miles WSW of Yaak's town point (Wikipedia, 48.83056 N, 115.70889 W), matching the page. Record county Lincoln is correct. Two web searches found nothing else on Lucky Point; the Lincoln County list is the only other mention found. No staffing or fire sources found.
